from sympy.solvers.solvers import solve
from sympy.core.sympify import sympify
eq = {equation}
var = sympify({variable})
expr = sympify(eq.split('=', 1)[0]) - sympify(eq.split('=', 1)[1]) if '=' in eq else sympify(eq)
res = solve(expr, var, dict=True)
res = [res] if isinstance(res, dict) else res
[str(d[var]) for d in res]

from sympy.solvers.solvers import solve
from sympy.core.sympify import sympify
lines = [s.strip() for s in {equations}.split('\n') if s.strip()]
exprs = [sympify(s.split('=', 1)[0]) - sympify(s.split('=', 1)[1]) if '=' in s else sympify(s) for s in lines]
syms = [sympify(v.strip()) for v in {variables}.split(',')]
res = solve(exprs, *syms, dict=True)
res = [res] if isinstance(res, dict) else res
[{str(k): str(v) for k, v in d.items()} for d in res]
